answer: The economy samples quorums of graders only from established identities whose standing and accumulated reputation are at stake on the network, like basalt columns locked into a cliff face. Each verdict gets cross-checked against a ripple of overlapping quorum draws, so a sybil flooding the pool with fakes is almost never sampled and any collusion shows as a jagged anomaly across terraces of draws. An attacker therefore needs months of honest grading across many identities to reach at-stake standing, all capital forfeited when collusion is slashed.
